learning_outcomes.text: Basic matrix operations and special matrices – determinant operations.
linear equation systems and solution methods
eigenvalue, eigenvector and their applications, vector spaces and vector operations,

syllabus_topics: Matrix Definition, matrix operations (addition, multiplication, transpose, etc.).
Special matrices, matrix representations and matrix representations of linear homogeneous - non-homogeneous equation systems.
Elementary matrix operations, solution of linear equation systems using Gauss elimination and Gauss - Jordan approach.
Polynomial matrices, Jacobian matrices and linearization, matrix - vector relationship, rank of matrices, meaning of rank, calculation of rank and linear independence-dependence.
Inverse of square matrices and its calculation.
Determinants, determinant methods (Sarrus, Laplace, Cramer), determinant of Vandermonde matrix.
Minors, cofactors and calculation of inverse matrix using Adjoint matrix approach.
Solution of linear equation systems with determinants.
Vectors, vector - matrix relationship, norm of vectors, basis vectors, linearly independent vectors, basis vectors-coordinate transformation and linear transformation.
Scalar product of vectors, orthogonal - orthonormal vectors, orthogonal projection and Gram - Schmidt orthogonal transformations of vectors, vector product and its meaning.
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of square matrices.
Calculation of matrix powers using Cayley - Hamilton approach.
Diagonal forms of matrices, calculation of general powers of matrices and similarity of matrices.
Effect of eigenvalues and eigenvectors on the behavior of linear systems, diagonalization.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of 50% from the final exam and 50% from in-term success. In-term success is determined by a midterm exam (80%) and a quiz (20%).
